name: Vol-stratified dual-regime: calm-trend + storm-reversion switch
rationale: THESIS: the single edge is the SWITCH itself — vol regime selects which playbook to run. The same instrument should be traded as a trend in calm tapes and as a reversion in storms; running either playbook regime-blind loses in the wrong half of the vol distribution. Here we implement the LOW-vol-armed trend leg (vol_realized<ceiling BOUNDED + ret_Nd>0) as the entry; its high-vol-reversion mirror (vol_realized>floor + RSI<oversold) is filed as the sibling spec so the Gate can run them as a stratified pair. The disconfirmer is shared and decisive. DISCONFIRMER: (1) low-vol-trend leg must beat trend-blind momentum; (2) the high-vol-reversion sibling must beat dip-blind reversion; (3) a vol-BLIND blend that takes both signals regardless of regime must UNDERPERFORM the stratified pair on deflated-Sharpe net of the extra turnover. If the blind blend matches the switch, vol does not select the playbook and the stratification is fitted noise.
catalyst: Realized vol is in the calm regime and price trend is up — the trend leg of the vol-stratified switch fires (the storm-reversion leg fires from its sibling spec in high-vol).
